title: VP, Foundry Operations
text:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time.
 
 
At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management, and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creative thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.
 
 
Requisition ID: 79081
 
 
**Description**
The Vice President of Foundry Operations provides global leadership for Skyworks' external wafer-foundry manufacturing network. The executive owns the operating system that converts technology and product roadmaps into predictable supply, benchmark yield and zero-defect quality, competitive cost, timely NPI ramps, and resilient high-volume production.
 
 
The role integrates Foundry Operations with Foundry Engineering and Supplier Quality, serving as the primary executive interface to strategic foundry partners and aligning Business Units, Design, Product Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Finance, and Foundry Technology.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Global Foundry Strategy & Executive Supplier Leadership
 
 
Define and execute the external foundry operating strategy aligned with product, technology, supply, cost, continuity, compliance, and resilienc
 
 
Lead executive supplier relationships, governance, business reviews, escalations, and joint improvement roadmaps with strategic foundry partners
 
 
Represent Global Operations with foundry executive leadership, communicating performance expectations, transformation priorities, audits, Si technology node HVM readiness, and joint improvement commitments
 
 
Delivery Execution
 
 
Own operational execution from purchase-order issuance through wafer delivery and goods receipt, with transparent supply visibility and disciplined recovery plans
 
 
Manage cycle-time performance, technology transfer and capacity expansion readiness, production ramps, and hot lot management. Partner with SCM, Sourcing, Engineering, and Business Units to protect Skyworks revenue
 
 
Ensure supply plans are feasible and on schedule, with transparent visibility, rapid escalation, and disciplined recovery plans that reflect revenue, absorption, manufacturing cost, and ROI
 
 
Foundry Engineering, Yield, Quality & Process Control
 
 
Drive benchmark probe and final-test yield across external foundries through defect-density benchmarks, product data, and structured yield roadmaps, backed by robust in-line metrology, PCM, SPC/WECO, FDC, and critical-parameter controls
 
 
Establish a zero-defect, source-containment culture and systematically improve Mean-Time-to-Detect and Mean-Time-to-React using real-time indicators of emerging risk
 
 
Quality-excursion containment, root-cause analysis, material disposition, corrective action, verification of non-recurrence (8D reviews), and foundry change-control governance
 
 
NTI to NPI and HVM Ramp Readiness
 
 
Global Operations quality rigor and design for manufacturing through an end-to-end Foundry Ramp Readiness system (NTI oversight, pre-ramp readiness, ramp verification, clean launch, HVM stabilization, and critical production mass) with defined gates, ownership, and escalation
 
 
Verify foundry capability, capacity, yield, quality, cycle time, and supply before ramp and customer commitments, partnering with Foundry Technology, Design, Product Engineering, Quality, SCM, and Business Units to close gaps and protect schedules
 
 
**Responsibilities Continued**
Competitive Performance & Operations Excellence
 
 
Deploy and sustain the Performance Management System (PMS) within Foundry Operations
 
 
Establish competitive benchmarks, aggressive KPI targets, review cadence, and continuous-improvement roadmaps across technology, cost, productivity, quality, yield, cycle time, delivery, and responsiveness
 
 
Cost, Productivity & Financial Performance
 
 
Own foundry VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) cost and productivity roadmaps, yield improvement, cycle time, capacity utilization, and supplier value creation
 
 
Partner with Sourcing and Supply chain on capacity commitments, long-term agreements, and NRE, balancing cost, quality, delivery, technology access, continuity, and compliance in supplier decisions
 
 
Digital Operations, Analytics & Organizational Leadership
 
 
Automate repetitive workflows and provide early warnings of excursions, delivery misses, capacity constraints, and cycle-time changes
 
 
Use analytics and a single source of operational truth to prioritize action, monitor PDCA closure, and improve decision speed and accountability
 
 
Lead and develop a global, matrixed, and multicultural team spanning fab operations, engineering, yield, supplier quality, and analytics; build succession depth and critical capabilities
 
 
Communicate decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recovery plans with executive presence across internal leaders, foundries, foundry suppliers, and, when required, Skyworks customers
 
 
**Required Experience And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or a related discipline required; master's degree, MBA, or advanced technical degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive semiconductor manufacturing, foundry, technology development, product engineering, supply chain, or operations leadership experience, including significant global responsibility.
* Deep end-to-end understanding of wafer fabrication, critical process modules, design/process interaction, yield ramp, process control, quality systems, NPI, and high-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success managing external foundries, executive supplier relationships, capacity, technology transfers, production ramps, quality excursions, and cross-functional recovery programs.
* Proven ability to use operational data, analytics, and insights to drive execution; experience with Power BI or comparable business-intelligence tools is valued.
* Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to operate at strategic and hands-on levels across technical, commercial, and operational issues.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

**Desired Experience And Skills**

* Strategic thinking and semiconductor business acumen
* People and organizational leadership
* Change leadership and operational transformation
* Decisive, data-based judgment under uncertainty
* Customer focus and cross-functional influence
* Accountability for results, ethics, safety, and quality

The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is currently USD $206,900 - $454,100 per year. Starting base pay will depend on relevant experience and skills, training and education, business needs, market demands, the ultimate job duties and requirements, and work location. Skyworks has different base pay ranges for different work locations in the U.S. Benefits include access to healthcare benefits (including a premium-free medical plan option), a 401(k) plan and company match, an employee stock purchase plan, paid time off (including vacation, sick/wellness, parental leave), among others. Employees are eligible to participate in an incentive plan, and certain roles are also eligible for additional awards, including recognition and stock. These incentives and awards are based on individual and/or company performance.
 
 
Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Skyworks strives to create an accessible workplace; if you need an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@skyworksinc.com.
